summary: Discover how ISO/IEC 27400 Lead Manager can streamline your project management. Enhance efficiency and drive success with our expert insights and resources.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for securing IoT ecosystems and managing connected device risks across organizational boundaries.
modules: IoT Security Foundations and Lifecycle Management
IoT Asset Management and Risk Assessment
IoT Security and Privacy Controls Implementation
IoT Security Monitoring and Incident Management
prerequisites: Participants attending this course must be familiar with ISO/IEC 27400 and related standards, such as ISO/IEC 30141, ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27005, and others, as well as IoT security and privacy practices.
